en: The image depicts an old, black-and-white postcard showing a scenic view of a lakeside area with a turreted building, possibly a pavilion or villa, to the left. There are people sitting and walking near the water, some boats on the lake, and trees lining the background. The landscape is tranquil and the style of clothing suggests an early 20th-century setting. The upper right corner of the card has the text 'Graz. Hilmteich.'
